# routeros_tool_traffic_generator_packet_template (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_tool_traffic_generator_packet_template" "template" {
  name                         = "example"
  comment                      = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  compute_checksum_from_offset = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the packet template, referenced by `tx_template` of a stream.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `compute_checksum_from_offset` (String) Byte offset at which the generator starts computing the two byte checksum that is placed into the packet, or `no-checksum` to leave the checksum untouched.
- `data` (String) How the packet payload following the headers is filled.
- `data_byte` (String) Byte value in hexadecimal notation (`00`..`FF`) used to fill the payload when `data=specific-byte`.
- `header_stack` (String) Comma separated sequence of headers the generated packet consists of, for example `mac,ip,udp`.
- `interface` (String) Interface the packets built from this template are sent out of. Mutually exclusive with `port`.
- `ip_dscp` (String) Comma separated list of DS field values placed into the IP headers.
- `ip_dst` (String) Comma separated list of destination addresses (`address` or `address/netmask`) for the IP headers.
- `ip_frag_off` (String) Comma separated list of fragment offset values placed into the IP headers.
- `ip_gateway` (String) Next hop address the generator resolves to obtain the destination MAC address when `mac-dst` is not given.
- `ip_id` (String) Comma separated list of identification field values placed into the IP headers.
- `ip_protocol` (String) Comma separated list of protocol values placed into the IP headers, specified by protocol name (`tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `gre`, …) or by number.
- `ip_src` (String) Comma separated list of source addresses (`address` or `address/netmask`) for the IP headers.
- `ip_ttl` (String) Comma separated list of time to live values placed into the IP headers.
- `ipv6_dst` (String) Comma separated list of destination addresses for the IPv6 headers.
- `ipv6_flow_label` (String) Comma separated list of flow label values placed into the IPv6 headers.
- `ipv6_gateway` (String) Next hop IPv6 address the generator resolves to obtain the destination MAC address when `mac-dst` is not given.
- `ipv6_hop_limit` (String) Comma separated list of hop limit values placed into the IPv6 headers.
- `ipv6_next_header` (String) Comma separated list of next header values placed into the IPv6 headers, specified by protocol name (`tcp`, `udp`, `icmpv6`, …) or by number.
- `ipv6_src` (String) Comma separated list of source addresses for the IPv6 headers.
- `ipv6_traffic_class` (String) Comma separated list of traffic class values placed into the IPv6 headers.
- `mac_dst` (String) Comma separated list of destination MAC addresses (`MAC` or `MAC/MASK`) for the MAC headers.
- `mac_protocol` (String) Comma separated list of ethertypes placed into the MAC headers, specified by name (`ip`, `ipv6`, `arp`, `vlan`, `service-vlan`, `mpls-unicast`, …) or by number.
- `mac_src` (String) Comma separated list of source MAC addresses (`MAC` or `MAC/MASK`) for the MAC headers.
- `port` (String) Name of the `/tool/traffic-generator/port` entry the packets built from this template are sent out of. Mutually exclusive with `interface`.
- `random_byte_offsets_and_masks` (String) List of `offset:mask` pairs describing which packet bytes are randomized and which bits of them may change.
- `random_ranges` (String) Ranges the randomized header field values are taken from.
- `raw_header` (String) Content of a `raw` header as a hexadecimal string.
- `special_footer` (Boolean) Whether a special footer with a sequence number and a timestamp is appended to every packet. It is required for latency and out of order measurements.
- `tcp_ack` (String) Comma separated list of acknowledgment number values placed into the TCP headers.
- `tcp_data_offset` (String) Comma separated list of data offset values placed into the TCP headers.
- `tcp_dst_port` (String) Comma separated list of destination ports (`port` or `port/mask`) for the TCP headers.
- `tcp_flags` (String) Comma separated list of TCP flags set in the generated TCP headers.
- `tcp_src_port` (String) Comma separated list of source ports (`port` or `port/mask`) for the TCP headers.
- `tcp_syn` (String) Comma separated list of sequence number values placed into the TCP headers.
- `tcp_urgent_pointer` (String) Comma separated list of urgent pointer values placed into the TCP headers.
- `tcp_window_size` (String) Comma separated list of window size values placed into the TCP headers.
- `udp_checksum` (String) Comma separated list of checksum values placed into the UDP headers, or `compute` to let the generator calculate them.
- `udp_dst_port` (String) Comma separated list of destination ports (`port` or `port/mask`) for the UDP headers.
- `udp_src_port` (String) Comma separated list of source ports (`port` or `port/mask`) for the UDP headers.
- `vlan_id` (String) Comma separated list of VLAN identifiers placed into the VLAN headers.
- `vlan_priority` (String) Comma separated list of PCP values placed into the VLAN headers.
- `vlan_protocol` (String) Comma separated list of ethertypes carried by the VLAN headers, specified by name (`ip`, `ipv6`, `vlan`, `service-vlan`, …) or by number.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/tool/traffic-generator/packet-template get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_tool_traffic_generator_packet_template.template "*1"
```
